Credit insurance includes a Conventional Program insuring up to 80 percent (not to exceed $2.5 million) or 90 percent for export transactions; a Bond Program insuring bonds up to 100 percent (not to exceed $7.5 million); and Linked Deposits providing certificates of deposit in certain rural high-unemployment areas to enable below-market-rate loans to eligible small businesses.

structured_extraction.program_description: Comprehensive tax incentives and support programs offered by Washington County to support business development, expansion, workforce training, and economic growth. Includes state and local tax credits, workforce development programs, utility incentives, and specialized incentive programs.
structured_extraction.assistance_description: Multiple assistance types available: (1) Tax Credits: Job Creation & Capital Investment Real Property Tax Credit (6-15 years, 26-100% of county real property taxes based on investment level); New Jobs Tax Credit (6 years, 52% years 1-2, 39% years 3-4, 26% years 5-6); Pad-Ready Site Commercial Stimulus Program (3-year credit on 0.4% of construction costs); Brownfield Revitalization Incentive Program (50-70% real property tax credit for 5 years, up to 10 years in Enterprise Zones). (2) Tax Exemptions: Research & Development equipment, manufacturing machinery and equipment, business inventory exempt from County Business Personal Property Tax. (3) State Tax Advantages: No unitary tax on profits, no income tax on foreign dividends, no gross receipts tax on manufacturers, no corporate franchise tax. (4) Loans: Hagerstown Revolving Loan Fund up to $200,000 (80% of project cost) at LIBOR+1% minimum 3%, fixed rate, 7-year term; microenterprise loans up to $5,000; working capital loans up to $30,000. C-PACE loans for energy efficiency and renewable energy projects with up to 100% fixed-rate financing and 20-year payback. (5) Grants: City Center Redevelopment ($150,000-$250,000 with 2:1 match), City-Wide Redevelopment ($5,000-$25,000 with 2:1 match), CDBG Microenterprise grants, Invest Hagerstown programs ($7,500 for down payment/rehabilitation). (6) Utility Incentives: Potomac Edison offers up to $1M in incentives for energy efficiency, LED lighting, HVAC systems, chillers, VFDs, and other equipment retrofits. (7) Workforce Development: Training reimbursement up to $4,500 per worker through Western Maryland Consortium; apprenticeship programs with tax credits; custom training through Hagerstown Community College; aviation maintenance technician training at Pittsburgh Institute of Aeronautics. (8) Foreign Trade Zone Benefits: Nearly 1,700 acres in FTZ #255 with materials used/consumed exempt from duties.
structured_extraction.application_deadline_string: Ongoing; specific programs may have rolling deadlines
structured_extraction.contact_name: Washington County Department of Business and Economic Development; City of Hagerstown Community and Economic Development; Program-specific coordinators

structured_extraction.program_audience: For-profit businesses located in or relocating to Washington County seeking to expand operations, create jobs, improve energy efficiency, or access workforce development. Non-profits and developers may qualify for specific programs. Microenterprises with 5 or fewer employees eligible for targeted programs.
structured_extraction.use_of_funds: Business expansion and relocation, capital improvements, equipment and machinery purchases, research and development, manufacturing operations, energy efficiency and renewable energy projects, employee training and recruitment, code compliance, façade enhancement, working capital, land improvements, building construction and renovation, leasehold improvements.
structured_extraction.geographic_eligibility: Washington County, Maryland, with specific incentives for designated Enterprise Zones (Hagerstown-Washington County Enterprise Zone covering ~5,000 acres including Hopewell Valley Industrial Park, City Business Park, downtown Hagerstown; Town of Hancock Enterprise Zone covering ~1,500 acres). Priority Funding Areas designated in Title 5, Subtitle 7B of State Finance and Procurement Article. Foreign Trade Zone #255 includes approximately 1,700 acres across multiple locations: Hagerstown Regional Airport (~387 acres), Williamsport Interstate Industrial Park (~140 acres), Hopewell Valley (~470 acres), Lakeside Corporate Center at Cascade (~279 acres), Hancock (~128 acres). City of Hagerstown programs require location within corporate city boundaries or at least two-thirds of business operations within city limits for roving businesses.
requirements_list: Job Creation & Capital Investment: Section 4(a) requires minimum 1,500 sq ft new/expanded premises and at least 1 new permanent full-time employee within 12 months; Section 4(b) requires minimum 2,500 sq ft and at least 5 new permanent full-time employees within 24 months; Section 4(c) requires $10M capital investment and 100 new permanent full-time employees

New Jobs Tax Credit: Minimum 10,000 sq ft construction/expansion, minimum 25 new permanent full-time positions, 50% of new jobs must pay at least 135% of average weekly wage, must be in Priority Funding Area
Pad-Ready Site Commercial Stimulus: Qualified projects must be approved; construction must be completed and buildings occupied
Brownfield Revitalization: Site must be in participating jurisdiction, must be owned by inculpable person, located in qualifying brownfield

CDBG Microenterprise: 5 or fewer total employees including owner, private for-profit business, good standing with City and State, compliance with City regulations, established and operating at least 12 months (or business plan and counseling consultation required)

Hagerstown Revolving Loan Fund: Business sales less than $5M annually for last 2 years, credit check required, non-refundable application fee, minimum $10,000 loan, maximum $200,000 or 80% project cost
Enterprise Zone: Qualifying businesses with job creation and capital investments in designated zones eligible for state income tax credits and local real property tax credits
Workforce Training: Various programs available; Western Maryland Consortium provides no-cost services; apprenticeship programs available through Maryland Department of Labor
All businesses must be in good standing with applicable jurisdictions and comply with federal, state, and local regulations
structured_extraction.application_process_overview: Applications processed through Washington County Department of Business and Economic Development (www.washco-md.net/business-development) or City of Hagerstown Community and Economic Development (for city-specific programs). Microenterprise and Revolving Loan Fund applicants download guidelines and application forms from program websites. CDBG Microenterprise applicants must verify location within city boundaries and employee count. Loan applicants submit application with credit check authorization and non-refundable fee. Tax credit applications submitted through county with documentation of capital investment and job creation. C-PACE applications handled through Abacus Property Solutions on behalf of Maryland Clean Energy Center (www.md-pace.com). Workforce development services through Western Maryland American Job Center (301-393-8200), Western Maryland Consortium (301-791-3164), or individual training providers. Priority plan review available for Pad-Ready Site Commercial Stimulus applicants. Contact county department at (240) 313-2280 or visit www.washco-md.net/business-development for specific program details and application materials.

structured_extraction.program_name: Job Creation and Capital Investment Real Property Tax Credit
structured_extraction.program_description: This program provides up to a fifteen-year real property tax credit on the County portion of real estate taxes for qualified businesses that either expand or locate in Washington County and meet specific investment and job creation thresholds. It helps attract new companies and supports existing companies that expand in Washington County. The program offers real property tax credits on the increased assessed property value for eligible businesses, organized into three tiers based on investment and job creation levels.
structured_extraction.agency: Washington County Department of Business Development
structured_extraction.assistance_description: Real property tax credits on the increased assessed property value for up to 15 years, for newly constructed, renovated, expanded, or previously unoccupied properties (owned or leased). Three tiers available: TIER ONE (1,500 sq. ft., 5 new FTEs within 12 months) receives 3 years of credits at 55%, 40%, 25%; TIER TWO (2,500 sq. ft., 25 new FTEs within 24 months) receives 6 years of credits at 55%, 55%, 40%, 40%, 25%, 25%; TIER THREE ($20M investment, 200 new FTEs within 24 months with 80% paid at 200% of Maryland State minimum wage) receives 15 years of credits at 75% for the first five years, then reduced by 5% annually over the next 10 years until reaching 25%. Businesses located in an Enterprise Zone are not eligible.
structured_extraction.application_deadline_string: Rolling, before occupying space or completing construction
structured_extraction.program_audience: For-profit businesses that expand or locate in Washington County and meet specific investment and job creation requirements. Businesses in Enterprise Zones are not eligible for this program.
structured_extraction.use_of_funds: Real estate tax credit on the increased assessed property value of newly constructed, renovated, expanded, or previously unoccupied properties.
structured_extraction.geographic_eligibility: Washington County. Eligible properties must be newly constructed, renovated, expanded, or previously unoccupied and can be owned or leased. Businesses located in an Enterprise Zone are not eligible.
requirements_list: Must be located in Washington County (not in an Enterprise Zone).
Properties must be newly constructed, renovated, expanded, or previously unoccupied (owned or leased).
Apply before occupying space, hiring employees, or completing construction.
TIER ONE: Expand by at least 1,500 sq. ft. and create at least 5 new full-time employees within 12 months.
TIER TWO: Obtain at least 2,500 sq. ft. of space and create at least 25 new full-time employees within 24 months.
TIER THREE: Invest at least $20,000,000 in capital improvements and create at least 200 new FTEs within 24 months, with 80% paid at 200% of Maryland State minimum wage.

Submit Annual Employment and Certification Report by February 1 each year, including employee names, last four digits of SSN, home city/state, employment dates, annual salary, hours worked, and benefits information.
Continue to meet all applicable program requirements each year to receive the tax credit.
structured_extraction.application_process_overview: 1. Submit a letter of intent and official application before completing construction or occupying new premises. 2. Provide intent letter, completed application, and employee certification information to the Washington County Department of Business and Economic Development (DBED). 3. Notify DBED that construction has been completed and provide square footage documentation. 4. Create required FTEs within 12 months for TIER 1 or 24 months for TIERs 2 and 3. 5. Submit Annual Employment and Certification Report by February 1 each year. 6. Receive certification from Washington County DBED. Businesses are strongly encouraged to engage with DBED early in their planning process. Failure to apply before hiring or occupying new premises may result in ineligibility for the tax credit.
